rat.overview: 2028 feels like a year with a following wind for the Rat, as long as you keep your plans grounded. People seem more willing to listen to your ideas, and small introductions can lead somewhere useful over time. The Earth element brings a steady, practical tone, so slow and consistent effort tends to work better than sudden leaps. Use the early months to sort out what you really want so that later opportunities have somewhere clear to land.
rat.career: Teamwork is your strength this year, especially in projects that need quick thinking alongside careful follow-through. A colleague or former classmate may bring up an idea that matches your skills, so stay reachable and keep your updates clear. Write down agreements and timelines, because good momentum can hide small gaps in the details. If you lead a team, sharing credit generously will earn you lasting goodwill.
rat.money: Income may feel steadier than in recent years, though your spending can creep up when the mood is good. Keep a simple monthly record so you can see where the money actually goes, whether it is on dining out, family outings or home upkeep. Shared costs with friends or relatives work better when everyone agrees the terms in writing. Patience and a clear budget matter more this year than chasing quick returns.
rat.love: Warmth comes more easily in 2028, and social gatherings may bring pleasant new connections for single Rats. Couples may find it easier to plan things together, such as a renovation, a family trip or a shared routine at home. Say what you appreciate out loud rather than assuming your partner already knows. Small, regular gestures will build more trust than grand ones.
rat.health_wellbeing: A busy calendar is the main thing to watch, since a run of good opportunities can quietly eat into your rest. Protect regular sleep hours and plan quiet evenings between social commitments. A walk at a park connector or a swim before the day gets hot can help you stay balanced. If something keeps bothering you physically, it is sensible to have a professional take a look.
rat.tai_sui_note: The Rat forms part of the Monkey-Rat-Dragon three harmony, so it sits in a supportive relationship with the Monkey year's Tai Sui. Folk custom sees this as a year in which cooperation and helpful people come more easily. Some families still offer a quiet prayer of thanks at the start of the year, but a grateful and steady attitude matters just as much.

ox.overview: For the Ox, 2028 is a fairly even year with no direct clash or harmony with Tai Sui. That leaves room for your usual patience and reliability to do the work. The Monkey year moves quickly, and you may sometimes feel others are rushing ahead, but steady progress still counts. Choose one or two meaningful goals and give them consistent attention.
ox.career: Your dependability stands out in a year when many people chase new trends. Managers may give you tasks that need careful handling, and doing them well can quietly build your reputation. Try to be open to new tools or workflows instead of resisting change, since a small adjustment could save you hours. Speak up about your contributions during reviews so they are not overlooked.
ox.money: Money matters look stable if you keep to your habits and avoid impulsive decisions. This is a good time to tidy up records, check insurance details and review recurring subscriptions. Family requests may come up, so decide calmly what you can comfortably manage before agreeing. Slow and organised beats fast and uncertain this year.
ox.love: Relationships grow through reliability rather than excitement this year. Single Oxen may connect with someone through work, a hobby group or friends of friends, so let things develop at a natural pace. Couples benefit from loosening up a little, perhaps by trying a new hawker centre or weekend outing together. A bit of lightness helps your partner see your softer side.
ox.health_wellbeing: You tend to carry stress quietly, so build in regular ways to release it. Stretching after long desk hours and a consistent bedtime can make a noticeable difference. Light exercise with a friend may keep you more motivated than training alone. Listen to your body and check in with a professional if something lingers.
dos: Focus on one or two goals
ox.tai_sui_note: The Ox has no direct clash or harmony with the Monkey year's Tai Sui, so folk tradition treats 2028 as a neutral year. Your own effort and choices set the tone more than outside forces. Some people still mark the new year with a simple family prayer or blessing, but there is no special need for worry.

tiger.overview: 2028 brings the Tiger into clash with Tai Sui, and folk belief links such years with change and movement. You might see shifts at work, at home or in your routines, and not all of them will be planned by you. It helps to treat this as a year for adjusting well rather than forcing outcomes. Staying flexible and thinking before reacting will carry you a long way.
tiger.career: Workplace changes such as a restructure, new manager or new role may come up. Rather than pushing back quickly, take time to understand what the change asks of you and where you can add value. Keep relationships with colleagues polite and professional, even when opinions differ. Careful documentation and clear emails can prevent misunderstandings.
tiger.money: Expenses may come up unexpectedly, perhaps around home repairs, travel or family needs. A modest buffer and a simple budget can soften these surprises. Be cautious with large commitments and take your time comparing options. Avoid lending or guaranteeing loosely, and keep shared money arrangements transparent.
tiger.love: Emotions may run higher than usual, so choose calm moments for important talks. Couples can grow closer by facing changes as a team instead of blaming each other for stress. Single Tigers may meet interesting people while travelling or through new circles, but let trust build gradually. Patience and listening will matter more than winning an argument.
tiger.health_wellbeing: A year of movement asks for extra care with everyday safety. Take your time on the road, on stairs and during sports, and avoid rushing when tired. Regular sleep and quiet time help steady your mood when things feel unsettled. If a concern lingers, get proper professional advice rather than guessing.
tiger.tai_sui_note: The Tiger sits directly opposite the Monkey, so 2028 is a clash year with Tai Sui. Tiger and Monkey also appear together in the classic Tiger-Snake-Monkey punishment, which folk belief links with friction and the need for patience. Many people choose to pay respects to Tai Sui or carry a small blessing as a way to feel settled, though careful planning and calm conduct are just as helpful.

rabbit.overview: The Rabbit enters 2028 with no direct clash or harmony with Tai Sui, which makes for a fairly calm backdrop. The quick pace of the Monkey year may feel noisy at times, but your thoughtful nature helps you pick out what truly matters. This is a good year to refine skills and strengthen relationships quietly. Small, steady improvements can add up to something you are proud of.
rabbit.career: Your tact and careful eye are useful in a year full of fast talk and quick decisions. Offer to review plans or smooth communication between teams, as people will value this. A short course or certification could open doors later. Be clear about your boundaries so that helpfulness does not turn into an overload of extra tasks.
rabbit.money: Finances look manageable with steady habits. Set aside a fixed amount each month, even a small one, and review it every quarter. Be careful with group purchases or shared plans that sound exciting but are vague on details. Comfort spending on your home is fine if it stays within a plan you have agreed with yourself.
rabbit.love: Gentle, consistent attention helps relationships this year. Couples may enjoy creating small rituals, such as a weekly dinner or an evening walk around the estate. Single Rabbits may find connection through shared interests rather than crowded events. Say clearly what you need, because hinting may not be enough this year.
rabbit.health_wellbeing: You may absorb other people's stress, so make room for quiet recovery time. A tidy, calm corner at home can help you unwind after long days. Gentle exercise such as yoga, walking or swimming suits you well. Keep up routine check-ups and seek professional advice if anything feels off.
dos: Keep a calm corner at home
rabbit.tai_sui_note: The Rabbit has no direct clash or harmony with the Monkey year's Tai Sui, so folk tradition views 2028 as a steady, neutral year. Outcomes depend mostly on your own consistency and good judgment. Some families still make a simple new-year offering for peace of mind, but it is a personal choice rather than a necessity.

dragon.overview: For the Dragon, 2028 has a cooperative, forward-moving feel, as if people around you are more willing to row in the same direction. Ideas you have kept to yourself may finally find the right listener, especially in the first half of the year. Remember that support works best when you share credit generously and keep your promises small and reliable. Treat the year as a chance to build steady alliances rather than to chase one dramatic win.
dragon.career: Work may bring projects that need you to lead without taking over, such as coordinating a cross-team effort or guiding a newer colleague. Your confidence is an asset, but checking assumptions with quieter teammates will save you rework later. Mid-year could bring a chance to present your work to people above your usual circle, so keep notes on your results as you go. If a role change comes up, weigh the daily routine it brings, not only the title.
dragon.money: Money matters look best when they stay organised and unhurried. You may feel tempted to match the spending of friends or colleagues who seem to be doing well, but your own plans deserve their own pace. A simple monthly review of bills, subscriptions and household costs can show you where small leaks are. When family members raise shared expenses, such as renovation or parents' needs, put the numbers on paper together before agreeing to anything.
dragon.love: Warmth comes easily this year, and you may find conversations with a partner feel lighter and more playful. Singles might meet someone through friends or a group activity rather than by searching hard. Watch the habit of deciding plans for both of you; asking first makes the other person feel truly included. Small rituals, like a weekly hawker dinner or an evening walk around the estate, can quietly strengthen a bond.
dragon.health_wellbeing: Your energy may run high, which makes it easy to overcommit and then feel scattered by evening. Build in short pauses between tasks and protect your sleep, especially during busy work stretches. Movement you enjoy, such as swimming or a regular park walk, can help you clear your head. If stress builds, talking it through with a trusted friend often helps more than pushing through alone.
dos: Keep a record of your wins
dragon.tai_sui_note: The Dragon forms a three harmony with the Monkey year, part of the Monkey-Rat-Dragon water trio. In folk belief this suggests helpful people and smoother cooperation. Some families still like to offer a quiet prayer of thanks at the start of the year, but a grateful and generous attitude is the heart of the custom.

snake.overview: For the Snake, 2028 carries a mix of attraction and friction, so relationships may feel close one day and tense the next. Opportunities may arrive through partnerships, yet the terms will need careful reading. Patience and clear agreements will serve you better than quick handshakes. If you keep your boundaries kind but firm, this can become a year of meaningful connection.
snake.career: Joint projects and partnerships may feature strongly at work, and you could be paired with someone whose style differs sharply from yours. Put roles and deadlines in writing early so misunderstandings do not grow later. Your sharp judgement is valued, but share it with tact, especially in meetings. Around mid-year, a steady approach to a difficult task may earn you quiet respect from those who decide promotions.
snake.money: Money linked to other people, such as shared purchases, family contributions or group arrangements, deserves extra clarity. Keep receipts and simple notes so everyone remembers what was agreed. You may notice small, unexpected household costs, so a modest cushion in your budget can ease worry. Avoid making financial commitments while feeling pressured or rushed; a night's sleep often brings a clearer view.
snake.love: Romance may feel intense, with strong attraction alongside moments of misunderstanding. Couples can benefit from speaking plainly about needs instead of expecting the other person to guess. Singles may meet someone intriguing, but letting trust build slowly is wise. When disagreements arise, step back before replying, and return to the conversation when both of you are calm.
snake.health_wellbeing: Emotional ups and downs may affect your rest more than usual. A calm evening routine, with screens put away earlier, can help your mind settle. Gentle exercise such as stretching, yoga or a slow walk along a park connector may release tension. Make time for friends who make you laugh, as lightness is a good balance for a serious year.
snake.tai_sui_note: The Snake and Monkey share a six harmony, yet classic texts also list them within the Tiger-Snake-Monkey punishment, so the bond is friendly but can bring friction. Folk custom sees this as a year to be careful with agreements and words. Some people choose to make a Tai Sui offering at the start of the year for peace of mind, though careful, considerate conduct matters most.

horse.overview: For the Horse, 2028 looks fairly even, with no strong pull from the year's Tai Sui either way. That gives you room to set your own direction and move at a pace that suits you. Your energy and enthusiasm can carry plans far, as long as you finish what you begin. Think of this as a year to consolidate and refine rather than to scatter your efforts.
horse.career: Work may offer a steady stream of tasks rather than big turning points, which is a good setting for building skill. Choose one area you want to be known for and deepen it through a course or practical project. Restlessness may tempt you to jump between tasks, so a simple weekly plan can keep you on track. Colleagues will appreciate your energy most when you follow through reliably.
horse.money: Your finances benefit from routine this year. Set up simple habits, such as tracking spending on your phone and reviewing it at the end of each month. Spontaneous treats are fine in moderation, but large purchases deserve a cooling-off period. If friends or relatives propose shared plans involving money, ask for details and take your time to decide.
horse.love: Relationships can feel comfortable, and that is a good moment to deepen them with honest conversation. Couples may enjoy planning shared goals, such as a short trip or a home project. Singles might find connection through activities they genuinely enjoy, like sports or volunteering. Try to listen fully before offering solutions; being heard matters a lot to the people close to you.
horse.health_wellbeing: You may feel driven to keep moving, so remember that rest is part of performing well. Balance intense exercise with stretching and proper recovery. Watch late nights, especially after social events in the middle of the week. Time outdoors, whether at a beach or a nature trail, can refresh your mind and mood.
horse.tai_sui_note: The Horse has no direct clash or harmony with the Monkey Tai Sui in 2028. This is generally seen as a neutral, steady year where your own choices shape the results. Some still like to say a simple blessing at the new year, but no special observance is traditionally expected.

goat.overview: For the Goat, 2028 feels calm and workable, with no strong push or pull from the year's Tai Sui. It is a good year to tend the parts of life that need care, such as home, routines and close friendships. Your gentle persistence can quietly produce solid results. Trust your own pace rather than measuring yourself against louder people around you.
goat.career: At work, your thoughtful and dependable style may be noticed, especially on tasks that need care and patience. Speak up a little more about your contributions so that good work does not go unseen. A creative idea you have been sitting on could be worth sharing around mid-year. If workload grows, discuss priorities with your supervisor rather than silently absorbing it all.
goat.money: Money matters look stable when you keep things simple and clear. Setting aside a small amount regularly can build confidence over the year. Be careful about lending money when it would strain you; it is fine to say no kindly. Household costs, from utilities to groceries, may be worth reviewing together with family to find easy savings.
goat.love: Love can feel tender and steady this year. Couples may enjoy slower, quality time together, like cooking at home or visiting family on weekends. Singles might find that a friendship gently grows into something more. Share your feelings openly instead of hoping they will be noticed, as clear warmth invites warmth back.
goat.health_wellbeing: You may absorb other people's moods, so make space for quiet time to reset. Regular meals and steady sleep will help your energy stay even. Light exercise you enjoy, such as tai chi, cycling or a walk around your block, can lift your spirits. Creative hobbies, like drawing, music or gardening on the corridor, can be especially soothing.
goat.tai_sui_note: The Goat has no direct clash or harmony with the Monkey Tai Sui this year. Folk tradition regards this as a quiet, neutral relationship. Some families offer a simple new year prayer for peace, but steady habits and kindness are considered the best way to welcome the year.

monkey.overview: 2028 is your own year, so expect to be noticed more and to feel the year more strongly than usual. Earth Monkey energy helps you think things through, and it suits plans you are willing to build slowly instead of rushing. Some months may feel like a review of old habits, routines and promises. If you treat the year as a reset, not a test, you will likely end it steadier and clearer about what matters.
monkey.career: At work you may be given more visibility, along with more scrutiny. Managers may want your ideas backed by numbers, timelines and follow-through, so keep notes and finish what you start before taking on something new. Office politics may feel louder than usual. Stay polite, document your decisions, and let consistent results speak for you. A quieter mid-year is a good time to learn a skill you can use properly next year.
monkey.money: Money matters reward patience this year more than clever shortcuts. Look over recurring costs such as subscriptions, insurance riders and household bills, and tidy anything that has quietly grown. Be careful with tips passed around in chat groups, and take time before making big commitments. A simple monthly check-in with your own spreadsheet or banking app can bring real peace of mind. Small, steady habits are likely to serve you better than bold moves.
monkey.love: In relationships, honesty and lighter moods will help more than proving a point. Couples may find that shared chores, family visits or HDB and condo logistics bring up old frustrations, so set aside calm time to talk instead of settling things in passing. Singles may meet people through work or community activities, but there is no need to hurry a label. Let trust build at its own pace. Kindness to parents and siblings will also make home feel warmer.
monkey.health_wellbeing: Your own year can feel tiring, so protect your sleep and give yourself proper rest after busy stretches. Gentle routines like evening walks at a park connector, regular meals and less late-night scrolling can make a noticeable difference. Look out for stress that shows up as irritability or restlessness. Talk to people you trust when things pile up, and see a professional whenever you have health questions. Calm is something you build day by day.
monkey.tai_sui_note: 2028 is a Monkey year, so this is your ben ming year (值太岁), traditionally seen as a time of change and closer attention. Some people follow folk customs such as wearing red or paying respects to Tai Sui at the start of the year. Whether or not you do, a careful pace and steady habits match the spirit of the tradition.

rooster.overview: For the Rooster, 2028 looks like a fairly even year with room to tidy up and strengthen what you already have. Earth Monkey energy rewards preparation, which suits your love of detail. Progress may come from refining your work rather than starting over. People around you are likely to value your reliability, so let it show quietly.
rooster.career: Work could bring practical tasks such as improving processes, training newer colleagues or cleaning up projects left half-done. Your precision is an asset, but avoid correcting others so often that it strains good working relationships. Share credit generously and ask questions before you assume. A cross-team project in the second half of the year may give you a good stage. Keep your portfolio or work records up to date.
rooster.money: Your finances may feel steady if you stick to a plan. This is a good year to set clear categories for household, family support and personal spending. Watch out for spending that is really about convenience or a reward after a long day. Before any larger purchase, compare options carefully and let a little time pass first. A tidy budget will likely give you more freedom than you expect.
rooster.love: Love grows through small, consistent gestures this year. Couples may enjoy simple routines like a weekly hawker dinner or a walk after work, which give you room to talk without pressure. Try not to judge your partner's habits too quickly. Singles might connect with someone who shares their values, often through friends. Patience and warmth will speak louder than perfect plans.
rooster.health_wellbeing: Balance comes from not overloading your calendar. Desk-heavy weeks call for stretching breaks, water and time away from screens. Make room for hobbies with no goals attached, like music, cooking or gardening along the corridor. Notice when perfectionism starts making you tense. For any health concerns, check with a qualified professional.
rooster.tai_sui_note: The Rooster has no direct clash or harmony with the 2028 Monkey Tai Sui, so the year is traditionally seen as neutral. Some families still mark the new year with quiet folk customs out of respect, but nothing special is expected. Steady effort is your best companion.

dog.overview: 2028 offers the Dog a calm year without strong pulls in any one direction. Earth Monkey energy favours practical problem-solving, and your loyalty and good sense fit that well. You may notice more requests for help from family and friends. Look after your own time while you support others, and the year should feel balanced.

Some families still choose to offer a quiet prayer or light incense at the start of the year as a gesture of respect, if it feels meaningful to you.

snake.overview: For the Snake, 2031 is a year of movement and adjustment, as your sign sits directly opposite the Pig. Changes may arrive at work, at home or in your routines, sometimes before you feel ready. The key is to stay flexible and respond calmly rather than resisting every shift. Handled thoughtfully, this year can clear out what no longer fits and make room for better arrangements.
snake.career: Expect shifting priorities, restructured teams or new reporting lines that require you to adapt. Your sharp judgement is valuable, but voice concerns diplomatically to avoid unnecessary friction with superiors. Document your contributions clearly so your work speaks for itself during reviews. If opportunities to relocate desks, change projects or travel appear, weigh them carefully rather than dismissing them outright.
snake.money: Cash flow may feel less predictable, so a modest buffer for unexpected expenses brings peace of mind. Be cautious with deals that sound unusually rushed or pressured, and read the fine print slowly. This is a good year to tidy up subscriptions, insurance details and household bills. For significant financial choices, consider seeking advice from a licensed professional before committing.
snake.love: Emotions can run a little higher this year, so pause before reacting to small irritations. Partnered Snakes benefit from honest, gentle check-ins about stress, especially around family or housing matters. Single Snakes may feel drawn to someone quite different from their usual type, so take time to get to know them. Kindness and clear communication keep the year's restlessness from spilling into close bonds.
snake.health_wellbeing: With more change around you, protecting your routines becomes important. Keep regular mealtimes and sleep hours even when schedules are disrupted. Take extra care on the roads and during outdoor activities, slowing down when you feel rushed. Calming habits such as stretching, journalling or quiet walks help you process the year's ups and downs.
snake.tai_sui_note: The Snake is in direct clash with the Pig Tai Sui in 2031, a relation traditionally linked with change and movement. Many people see this as a time to stay adaptable and avoid needless conflict. By folk custom, some choose to visit a temple to pay respects to Tai Sui or carry a small token, while others simply keep a calm, careful outlook.

horse.overview: For the Horse, 2031 offers a fairly open road with room to set your own pace. The Pig year's easygoing energy suits your love of freedom, as long as you keep an eye on follow-through. You may feel drawn to new interests, travel ideas or fresh starts in daily routines. Choose a few goals that genuinely matter and give them consistent attention.
horse.career: Work brings chances to show initiative, particularly in roles involving clients, events or moving between teams. Your enthusiasm is contagious, but be realistic about deadlines so promises match capacity. Mentors or senior colleagues may offer helpful guidance if you ask openly. The second half of the year is a good time to refine your portfolio or update your resume for future possibilities.
horse.money: Income looks steady, though spontaneous spending on travel and gadgets could add up. Setting aside a fixed portion each month for savings before spending helps keep balance. Avoid joining group purchases or ventures just because friends are excited. Simple tracking apps or a notebook can help you see patterns and make calmer choices.
horse.love: Your warmth draws people in, and social life could be lively this year. Partnered Horses should make room for quiet one-on-one time, not only group outings. Single Horses may connect with someone during travel, classes or hobby groups. Honesty about your need for space, shared gently, strengthens rather than weakens bonds.
horse.health_wellbeing: Your active nature serves you well, but watch for overcommitting and running on little sleep. Hydration matters, especially with Singapore's heat during outdoor activities. Balance intense exercise with stretching and recovery so your body keeps up with your plans. A regular wind-down routine in the evenings supports clearer thinking.
horse.tai_sui_note: The Horse has no direct clash or harmony with the Pig Tai Sui in 2031, suggesting a balanced year without strong pulls in either direction. Your own discipline and choices will set the tone. Some families keep the folk custom of a simple New Year prayer for peace, which you may follow if it brings you comfort.

goat.overview: For the Goat, 2031 brings supportive energy, as your sign forms a three harmony bond with the Pig. People around you may be more willing to help, and cooperation feels natural. This is a promising year to deepen relationships and move steady projects forward. Use the goodwill wisely by being generous and consistent in return.
goat.career: Teamwork is your strength this year, and colleagues may actively seek you out for collaborations. Creative or people-centred roles could see particular recognition. Speak up about your ideas in meetings, since your quieter style sometimes hides strong contributions. If a chance to take on more responsibility appears, consider it carefully and ask for the support you need.
goat.money: Finances feel more comfortable, with possible help coming through networks or joint efforts. Keep shared arrangements, such as household costs or group projects, clear and fair. A good year to build a regular savings habit while morale is high. For larger plans such as property or investments, gather information and consult qualified professionals before deciding.
goat.love: Love and family life feel warm and supportive. Partnered Goats may enjoy planning home improvements together or spending more time with extended family. Single Goats could find meaningful connections through friends or shared values. Expressing appreciation openly keeps this harmonious energy flowing.
goat.health_wellbeing: Your mood benefits from the year's gentle energy, but don't neglect basics while life feels good. Regular movement, balanced meals and enough sleep keep you resilient. Social plans can fill weekends quickly, so protect some time for solitude. Creative outlets such as cooking, music or gardening on your HDB balcony are especially restorative.
goat.tai_sui_note: The Goat enjoys a three harmony relation with the Pig Tai Sui in 2031, part of the Pig-Rabbit-Goat trio linked with cooperation and support. Many regard this as a favourable year for teamwork and goodwill. Some people mark it by the folk custom of offering thanks at the start of the year, though a grateful attitude matters just as much.

monkey.overview: For the Monkey, 2031 rewards patience more than cleverness. The Metal Pig year brings a gentler pace, and some of your quick plans may need a second look before they move forward. Small misunderstandings can build up if you assume others follow your thinking, so spell things out more often than feels necessary. If you treat the year as a time to tidy and strengthen what you already have, it can leave you on firmer ground.
monkey.career: At work, you may notice that colleagues or managers want more detail and more consultation than usual. Instead of seeing this as a delay, use it to show how carefully you prepare. Projects built with others tend to do better this year than solo efforts, especially from mid-year onward. Keep written records of agreements and handovers, since a quick verbal yes may be remembered differently later.
monkey.money: Money matters reward steady habits over bold moves this year. Review recurring bills, subscriptions and shared household costs, because small leaks are easier to catch than you expect. Be cautious about lending to friends or mixing money with favours, as expectations may not match. A simple monthly check-in with your own budget can bring real peace of mind.
monkey.love: In relationships, your wit is still charming, but your partner may want reassurance more than entertainment. Make time for unhurried conversations, perhaps a quiet walk at the park connector after dinner. Singles may meet someone through work or a community activity, and slow, honest getting-to-know-you suits the year. Try not to tease about tender topics, even playfully.
monkey.health_wellbeing: Your energy may come in bursts, so build in proper rest between busy weeks. Regular sleep and less late-night screen time can help your mood stay level. Gentle routines such as stretching, swimming or an evening stroll help clear a restless mind. If stress builds, talking it through with someone you trust is better than keeping it to yourself.
monkey.tai_sui_note: The Monkey and the Pig form a harm relation, which in folk belief points to small frictions and misread intentions rather than major trouble. Many people choose to keep a lower profile and be extra courteous during such years. Some families follow the custom of praying for peace with Tai Sui at the start of the year, which you may consider if it brings you comfort.

rooster.overview: For the Rooster, 2031 feels fairly open and steady. There is no direct clash or harmony with the Pig year, so much depends on your own choices and consistency. Your eye for detail becomes a real asset, especially when others feel scattered. This is a good year to refine routines, finish unfinished things and quietly raise your own standards.
rooster.career: Your careful work is likely to be noticed, even if praise arrives slowly. Volunteer for tasks that require accuracy or organisation, as these play to your strengths. Be mindful of tone when giving feedback, since a sharp comment can overshadow good advice. A learning course or certification taken this year may pay off in the following one.
rooster.money: Finances look stable when handled methodically. Your natural tendency to track details helps you spot unnecessary spending early. Set clear goals for savings and give yourself a small, planned treat so discipline does not feel harsh. Avoid making decisions based on hearsay from group chats.
rooster.love: Relationships grow warmer when you relax your expectations a little. Notice the effort your partner or family makes, not only what is missing. Singles may find connection through shared hobbies, and a slower pace suits you. Family meals, perhaps a regular weekend dinner, can strengthen bonds at home.
rooster.health_wellbeing: Your wellbeing benefits from structure, but avoid perfectionism in your exercise or diet plans. Consistent light activity often works better than intense bursts. Watch for tension in the shoulders and neck from long desk hours, and take short breaks. Time outdoors, even a short walk at a nearby park, helps reset your mind.
rooster.tai_sui_note: The Rooster has no direct clash or harmony with the Pig Tai Sui this year. In folk thinking, this is a calm, neutral position where steady effort matters most. Some people still offer a simple prayer for peace at the start of the year as a gentle custom, but there is no special pressure to do so.

dog.overview: For the Dog, 2031 offers a sense of quiet support. The Pig year sits beside your own sign and carries no direct clash, so the year feels workable and calm. Your loyalty and sense of fairness make you a trusted presence. Use this steadiness to build habits and relationships that will last.
dog.career: At work, you are likely to be relied upon, which brings both respect and extra load. Learn to say what you can realistically deliver so you do not quietly overextend. Teamwork tends to go smoothly, and a mentor or senior colleague may offer useful guidance. Opportunities may come through people you have helped before.
dog.money: Money matters look steady when you stick to sensible plans. You may feel pulled to support family or friends; set kind but clear limits. Keeping an emergency buffer brings a sense of security that suits your nature. Avoid impulse purchases made to cheer yourself up after a tiring week.
dog.love: Love feels comfortable and sincere this year. Couples may enjoy planning small shared goals, such as refreshing a room in the flat or a short trip together. Singles may find that friendships slowly turn into something more. Express your feelings openly rather than assuming they are understood.
dog.health_wellbeing: Your health benefits from balance between duty and rest. When you carry others' worries, make time to unwind on your own. Regular meals and steady sleep help you stay resilient. Activities with friends, such as a weekend hike or group exercise, lift your spirits.
dog.tai_sui_note: The Dog has no direct clash, punishment or harmony with the Pig Tai Sui in 2031. Folk tradition sees this as a neutral year where your own steady choices shape the outcome. Praying for peace at the start of the year is an optional custom some families keep.

pig.overview: 2031 is the Pig's own year, a time traditionally linked with change, reflection and fresh starts. You may feel more sensitive to pressure or more aware of what no longer suits you. Rather than forcing big shifts, focus on small, thoughtful adjustments. A calm, steady approach helps you make the most of this meaningful year.
pig.career: Work may bring new responsibilities or changes in direction, sometimes without much warning. Stay flexible and keep communication clear with your team and supervisors. Take time to think through any major decisions rather than reacting quickly. Building a good reputation for reliability can serve you well later.
pig.money: Money is best managed with caution and good records. Review your budget early in the year and plan for known expenses such as festive gatherings or household needs. Avoid being swayed by others' enthusiasm for quick gains. Steady saving brings more comfort than chasing big returns.
pig.love: Relationships may need extra patience as emotions run a little closer to the surface. Talk honestly about your needs and listen generously in return. Singles may prefer to take things slowly, which is perfectly fine this year. Family support can be a real anchor, so stay connected with loved ones.
pig.health_wellbeing: Pay attention to rest and emotional balance, since your own year can feel more intense. Gentle, regular exercise and enough sleep help you stay grounded. Avoid being too hard on yourself when things do not go to plan. Quiet hobbies such as reading, cooking or gardening can bring comfort.
pig.tai_sui_note: 2031 is the Pig's ben ming year, and folk belief also notes a self-punishment between Pig and Pig, hinting that inner stress can be the main challenge. Many people wear something red or keep a small token for luck during their own year. Some also choose to pray for peace with Tai Sui at the start of the year, a custom you may follow if it feels right for you.

rat.overview: 2032 is your own year, so expect it to feel personal, with much of the focus on you. Water Rat energy can make you quick, alert and full of ideas. It can also make you restless when plans don't move as fast as you'd like. Treat the year as a checkpoint rather than a race: look at what you've built over the last twelve years and decide what is worth keeping. Steady routines will help you more than sudden turns.
rat.career: At work, people may notice you more, which brings chances and also some scrutiny. Do the basics well: meet deadlines, write things down, and confirm who agreed to what before a project starts. If a new role or project comes up, ask about the scope and the people involved before you say yes. Middle of the year is a good time to update your skills quietly, maybe through a short course or a SkillsFuture-type programme, so you feel ready when the timing is right.
rat.money: Money this year rewards patience more than clever moves. Keep a simple monthly record of what comes in and what goes out, including small things like food delivery and subscriptions that add up. Hold off on lending larger sums to friends or relatives, even when the reason sounds good, until you've had a few days to think. A modest buffer for household or HDB-related costs will give you peace of mind when surprise bills turn up.
rat.love: In relationships you may be more sensitive than usual and read meaning into small comments. Before you react, ask a gentle question first. For couples, a shared weekly ritual such as a hawker breakfast or an evening walk at the park connector can keep you close when life gets busy. If you're single, you'll likely meet people through friends or community groups rather than in a dramatic way, and slow, sincere conversations will tell you more than first impressions.
rat.health_wellbeing: Your mind may run fast this year, so give it places to land. Regular sleep times, less screen time late at night and a short daily walk can steady your mood. Notice when you're taking on other people's worries as your own. If stress builds up, talking it over with someone you trust or a qualified professional is a sensible, ordinary step.
rat.tai_sui_note: As a Rat in a Rat year, you are in your ben ming year, sometimes described as sitting with Tai Sui. Many families keep the custom of wearing something red or paying respects to Tai Sui at the start of the year as a quiet gesture of humility. Whether you follow these customs or not, the spirit is the same: move steadily and stay modest.

ox.overview: For the Ox, 2032 feels cooperative and supportive. The Rat year's energy fits well with your steady nature, so other people may find it easier to work with you, and you with them. Things you've been building patiently could start to show progress, though gradually. Make good use of goodwill this year, but keep your own standards and pace.
ox.career: Teamwork is a strength this year. Colleagues or a supervisor may ask for your input or bring you into projects that need someone reliable. Say yes where it fits, and be clear about how much you can take on so you don't end up carrying everyone else's load. If you've been hoping for more responsibility, a calm conversation with records of your results, rather than a complaint, may be well received.
ox.money: Money looks steady when you stay disciplined. Partnerships and shared plans, such as family budgeting or splitting household costs, may go more smoothly than usual. Read every agreement properly and keep copies, even with people you trust. Avoid stretching yourself on purchases just because the mood feels optimistic; good timing is not a reason to overspend.
ox.love: Warmth comes more easily in relationships this year. Couples may find it a good time to settle long-standing small disagreements, maybe over a quiet meal rather than in the middle of a busy week. Singles could connect with someone through work, family introductions or a shared interest. Let affection show in small, steady actions, which is something the Ox already does well.
ox.health_wellbeing: Your stamina is generally good, but you tend to push through tiredness without noticing. Build in rest days, stretch after long hours at a desk and keep meals regular. Light activities with others, such as a weekend walk with family, can do you good in body and mood. Listen to your body's early signals instead of waiting until you're worn out.
ox.tai_sui_note: Ox and Rat form a six harmony pair, so your relationship with this year's Tai Sui is generally seen as harmonious. Folk custom treats it as a year of helpful connections and quiet support. Some people still mark the new year at a temple as a gesture of thanks, but the main thing is to make good use of the goodwill with sincerity.

tiger.overview: For the Tiger, 2032 is fairly neutral, so how the year goes depends mostly on what you put in. You may feel drawn to new challenges and quick wins. With some planning, that drive can turn into real progress. Choose a few clear goals and stay with them, rather than spreading your energy across too many directions.
tiger.career: Your initiative stands out, and you may be asked to lead or start something. Before you charge ahead, take time to get buy-in from the people affected, because support makes your work last. Some office politics may come up mid-year, and the best response is to keep to facts and stay courteous. Writing down your achievements regularly will help when it's time for appraisals.
tiger.money: Money is steady but needs attention. It's easy to make impulsive buys when you're feeling confident, so try a short waiting period before any non-essential purchase. Set aside something regularly, even if the amount is small, so you have a cushion. If a deal sounds unusually exciting, slow down and look at it properly before getting involved.
tiger.love: In love, your energy is attractive, but this year your partner may value patience more than grand gestures. Make time to listen fully, without fixing or competing. If you're single, you may meet someone through sport, travel or activities, and taking things at a natural pace will serve you better than rushing. Family members may also appreciate more of your time at home.
tiger.health_wellbeing: You tend to run hot and then crash, so balance is the theme this year. Pair intense exercise with proper warm-ups and recovery, and keep hydrated in Singapore's heat. Quiet activities such as reading, journaling or gardening on the corridor or balcony can help you reset. Look after your sleep, especially during busy work periods.
tiger.tai_sui_note: The Tiger has no direct clash or harmony with the Rat year's Tai Sui. Folk tradition sees this as a neutral year, where results depend mostly on your own effort and choices. Some people still say a simple new-year prayer for peace out of custom, but nothing in particular is called for.

rabbit.overview: For the Rabbit, 2032 may bring some friction, mostly in small ways, such as misread words or courtesies that feel uneven. Your gentle diplomacy is your best tool, but you'll need to back it up with clear boundaries. Expect that some plans will need a second try. When you stay calm and well organised, most bumps should pass without leaving marks.
rabbit.career: At work, be careful with tone and with what is written down. A casual message can be read the wrong way this year. Confirm instructions, especially when they're given verbally, and politely clarify anything unclear rather than guessing. If there's tension with a colleague, keep it professional and focused on the work, and bring in a neutral party only if it really helps.
rabbit.money: Money is manageable if you keep things simple. Double-check bills, transfers and contracts, since small mistakes are more likely this year. Steer clear of money arrangements that rely on vague promises, even among friends. A clear household budget, perhaps reviewed monthly with family, can stop misunderstandings about who pays for what.
rabbit.love: Relationships call for kindness and clarity together. Small irritations can grow if they're left unspoken, so bring them up early and gently. Couples may benefit from agreeing on simple ground rules for busy weeks, such as who handles which chores or family visits. If you're single, take time to get to know someone's character before you invest deeply, and trust consistency over charm.
rabbit.health_wellbeing: Emotional strain can turn into tiredness or tension, so build in gentle outlets. Regular walks, stretching, or a calm hobby like drawing or music can help release stress. Keep evenings peaceful where you can, and limit late-night scrolling through upsetting content. Reaching out to supportive friends or a qualified counsellor when things feel heavy is a healthy choice.
rabbit.tai_sui_note: Rat and Rabbit form a classic punishment relation, often called the 'uncivil' punishment, so this year's Tai Sui may bring friction around manners and misunderstandings. Some people choose to pay respects to Tai Sui early in the year or carry a small charm as a folk gesture of goodwill. Patience and courteous words are the most practical way to soften the year.

dragon.overview: The Water Rat year brings the Dragon a steady current that favours cooperation over solo effort. Plans you have been carrying quietly for a while can find willing partners, especially if you explain them clearly and early. The year rewards patience with detail: small, consistent steps tend to add up more reliably than one dramatic push. Keep your energy for what truly matters, and let some minor battles pass without comment.
dragon.career: Teamwork is your strongest asset this year, and colleagues may be more receptive to your ideas than usual. If you lead a project, sharing credit generously will build goodwill that pays off later in the year. Mid-year can bring a chance to take on wider responsibility, perhaps coordinating across departments or mentoring someone newer. Document your contributions as you go so that performance conversations feel grounded rather than rushed.
dragon.money: Money matters feel more orderly when you set simple routines, such as reviewing your accounts at the start of each month. Income from steady work looks more dependable than anything speculative, so treat windfalls as pleasant surprises rather than expectations. Household costs, whether for an HDB renovation or family commitments, are easier to manage when discussed openly with those involved. A clear written budget can ease quiet worries.
dragon.love: Relationships benefit from the year's harmonious tone, and conversations that once felt tense may soften. If you are attached, shared routines like weekend walks or cooking together can renew a sense of partnership. Single Dragons may meet someone through friends or community activities rather than chance encounters. Listening more than advising will make loved ones feel genuinely understood.
dragon.health_wellbeing: Your energy is generally good, but a busy social and work calendar can quietly drain it. Protect your sleep, especially during deadline seasons, and build in evenings with nothing scheduled. Gentle regular movement, such as a park connector walk or swimming, helps you stay grounded. Notice when irritability rises and treat it as a sign to rest rather than push harder.
dragon.tai_sui_note: The Dragon sits in three harmony with the Rat, together with the Monkey, so this year's Tai Sui is generally regarded as supportive. Folk custom sees this as a good time to strengthen alliances and build on existing goodwill. Some families simply offer thanks at the start of the year as a gesture of gratitude, though this is a personal choice.

snake.overview: For the Snake, the Water Rat year is fairly neutral, offering room to set your own pace. Without strong external pushes, your progress depends largely on the habits you choose and keep. This makes it a good year for quiet consolidation, learning, and tidying loose ends. By year's end, steady attention can leave you on firmer footing than you expected.
snake.career: Work is likely to feel stable, with fewer sudden changes than recent years. Use this calm to sharpen a skill, complete a course, or improve a process that has long bothered you. Your thoughtful style is valued, but make sure the right people see your work by sharing brief updates. Later in the year, a well-prepared proposal may receive a warmer reception than expected.
snake.money: Finances look steady if you stay disciplined and avoid impulse decisions. This is a sensible year to organise paperwork, review recurring subscriptions, and understand where your money actually goes. Be cautious about lending to acquaintances without clear terms, as misunderstandings can strain ties. Modest, consistent saving habits suit your temperament well.
snake.love: Love grows through small, sincere gestures rather than grand declarations. Attached Snakes may find that clearer communication about expectations removes long-standing friction. Single Snakes could connect with someone who shares a hobby or interest, so stay open to group activities. Try not to read too much into silences; ask kindly instead.
snake.health_wellbeing: Your wellbeing benefits from structure, so regular mealtimes and a consistent bedtime make a real difference. Long hours at a desk call for stretching breaks and attention to posture. Time in nature, such as the Botanic Gardens or a coastal walk, can quieten an overactive mind. Journalling may help you process thoughts you usually keep to yourself.
snake.tai_sui_note: The Snake has no direct clash or harmony with the Rat Tai Sui this year. Folk tradition treats this as a calm, neutral year where your own efforts shape outcomes. Some people still choose a simple blessing at the lunar new year for peace of mind, but it is entirely optional.

horse.overview: The Horse stands opposite the Rat, so 2032 may feel more changeable than usual. Plans can shift, and you may need to adjust course more than once. Rather than resisting every change, treat flexibility as your main strength this year. A calm, prepared approach turns unsettled moments into chances to grow.
horse.career: Workplace changes such as new managers, restructured teams, or moved deadlines may arrive with little warning. Staying adaptable and asking clarifying questions early will help you avoid misunderstandings. Double-check important emails and agreements before sending or signing. Your energy and initiative remain valued, especially when paired with careful follow-through.
horse.money: Money may feel less predictable, so building a small buffer for unexpected expenses brings peace of mind. Read terms carefully before committing to contracts, subscriptions, or large household purchases. Avoid making financial decisions when rushed or emotional; a short pause often brings clarity. Tracking spending weekly can reveal easy adjustments.
horse.love: Emotions may run warmer than usual, so patience with partners and family is important. Small disagreements are best settled quickly with a calm conversation rather than left to grow. Single Horses may find attractions spark fast; give connections time to show their substance. Shared quiet activities help restore balance when life feels busy.
horse.health_wellbeing: A restless year calls for routines that steady you, such as regular exercise and fixed rest days. Take extra care on the road and during sports, slowing down when you feel hurried. Stress can show up as poor sleep, so a wind-down habit without screens may help. Reach out to trusted friends when you need to talk things through.
avoids: Taking on too much at once
horse.tai_sui_note: The Horse is in direct clash with the Rat Tai Sui this year, which folk belief links to movement and change. Many people use such years to slow down, plan carefully, and keep relationships steady. Some families observe a custom of paying respects to Tai Sui early in the year for reassurance, though how you mark it is up to you.

goat.overview: The Goat shares a harm relationship with the Rat, suggesting a year where small misunderstandings deserve attention. Nothing needs to feel dramatic, but clarity in your words and dealings will spare you unnecessary friction. Your gentle, considerate nature is a real strength when paired with clear boundaries. Focus on trusted relationships and steady progress.
goat.career: At work, be mindful of office politics and avoid getting drawn into gossip. Put key decisions and instructions in writing to keep everyone on the same page. Your creativity and care can shine in projects that need thoughtful execution. A reliable mentor or senior colleague could offer guidance worth taking seriously.
goat.money: Financial matters call for caution with shared arrangements, such as group purchases or informal loans among friends. Keep receipts and records, especially for joint household expenses. Steady budgeting suits this year better than ambitious changes. If something seems unclear, ask questions before agreeing.
goat.love: Relationships thrive when you express needs directly rather than hoping others will guess. Attached Goats may benefit from regular check-ins about chores, finances, and family plans. Single Goats can take their time getting to know someone before opening up fully. Kindness towards yourself matters as much as kindness towards others.
goat.health_wellbeing: Emotional wellbeing deserves gentle care, as you may absorb others' stress without noticing. Creative outlets such as music, drawing, or cooking can be restorative. Keep meals regular and stay hydrated in the humid weather. Short daily walks help clear the mind after demanding days.
goat.tai_sui_note: The Goat and the Rat form a harm relationship, which folk tradition links to minor misunderstandings rather than major trouble. Clear communication and careful dealings are the traditional advice for such years. Some people choose to make a small offering or wear a token at the new year for comfort, but it remains a personal choice.

monkey.overview: 2032 feels like a year when the wind is mostly behind you, Monkey. The Water Rat sits in your three harmony group, so plans that felt stuck in earlier years can start moving with less effort. People tend to answer your messages faster and say yes more readily. The main risk is doing too much at once, so pick two or three goals and give them real attention.
monkey.career: Teamwork is your strongest tool this year. Projects that need quick thinking and good timing suit you, and colleagues may lean on you to connect people or fix messy handovers. If you have been hoping to move into a new role or learn a new skill, the first half of the year is a good time to put your hand up. Keep careful notes on what you deliver, because clear records will help at review time.
monkey.money: Income may feel steadier, and small chances to earn extra could come through people you already know. Treat these as a bonus, not a reason to loosen your budget. A simple monthly check of your bank and CPF statements keeps you grounded. Before any large commitment, take time to compare options and ask someone you trust to talk it through with you.
monkey.love: Your charm works well this year, and social plans come together easily. Singles may meet someone through friends, a class or a work gathering, so stay open to the invitation you almost turned down. If you are in a relationship, shared plans such as a trip, a home project or a new weekly routine can bring you closer. Listen as much as you talk, especially when your partner is tired.
monkey.health_wellbeing: A busy calendar is the main thing that can wear you down. Protect your sleep, and build short breaks into long days, even just a walk around the void deck or the office block. Water and light meals help in the humid months. When your mind keeps racing at night, writing tomorrow's list down before bed can help you let go of it.
dos: Keep written records of your work
monkey.tai_sui_note: The Monkey forms a three harmony with the Rat, so this year's Tai Sui is generally supportive of you. Folk custom sees this as a time when help from others comes more easily. Some people still choose to pay respects at a temple at the start of the year as a gesture of thanks, but it is a personal choice.

rooster.overview: For the Rooster, 2032 asks for patience and careful upkeep. In folk tradition the Rat and Rooster form a break relationship, which suggests small cracks in plans or arrangements that need attention before they grow. This is not a bad year, just one where checking details pays off. Steady, well-prepared steps will serve you better than bold leaps.
rooster.career: Expect some shifting at work, such as changed timelines, new reporting lines or a project that needs reworking. Your eye for detail is valuable now, so use it to spot problems early and raise them calmly. Confirm agreements in writing and check back on handovers. If a plan falls through, look for the useful part you can rescue rather than starting from zero.
rooster.money: Keep your finances simple and organised this year. Small leaks such as unused subscriptions or impulse online buys can add up, so a quarterly clean-up is worth doing. Try to keep a fixed sleep time even on weekends, and be mindful of rushing, which can lead to small knocks or strains. Sports and outdoor activity suit you, but warm up properly and pace yourself. Quiet moments, such as a slow tea break, can help you reset during hectic days.
dos: Make time for talks at home
avoids: Hurrying on wet floors and stairs
horse.tai_sui_note: The Horse forms a break relationship with the Rabbit Tai Sui in 2035, which folk belief associates with disrupted plans and small changes. Some people choose to pay respects to Tai Sui early in the year or carry a personal token for reassurance. Whatever you choose, staying flexible and organised is a grounded way to move through the year.

goat.overview: For the Goat, 2035 is a warm and supportive year. The Wood Rabbit shares a natural harmony with you, which can bring helpful people, easier cooperation and a sense of belonging. It is a good time to nurture creative ideas and invest effort in relationships. With steady effort, many small blessings can add up to a satisfying year.
goat.career: Teamwork goes well for you this year, and colleagues may welcome your gentle, thoughtful style. Projects involving design, care, service or community work are especially well suited to your strengths. Speak up when you have ideas, because people are more ready to listen than you might expect. A mentor or senior colleague may offer guidance that helps you plan your next step with confidence.
goat.money: Financial matters feel more settled, especially if you keep a clear plan for regular saving. Opportunities to earn extra through skills or side projects may appear, but check the time commitment before saying yes. Generosity comes naturally to you, so set a comfortable limit for gifts and treats. Reviewing your goals at mid-year can help you stay on course.
goat.love: Love and family life are bright spots in 2035. Couples may feel closer and find it easier to talk about future plans, such as home arrangements or family milestones. Single Goats may meet someone kind through friends, family gatherings or community events. Small acts of care, like cooking a favourite dish, will strengthen bonds beautifully.
goat.health_wellbeing: Your mood and energy are generally good, especially when you keep a balanced routine. Creative hobbies such as gardening, drawing or music can be deeply restoring for you. Be careful not to take on everyone else's worries, and protect some quiet time each week. Gentle exercise and regular meals will help you stay steady through busy festive periods.
goat.tai_sui_note: The Goat is part of the Pig, Rabbit and Goat three harmony group, so it sits in a friendly relationship with the Rabbit Tai Sui in 2035. Folk tradition sees this as a year of support and helpful connections. Some people still offer thanks to Tai Sui at the start of the year as a gesture of gratitude.

monkey.overview: For the Monkey, 2035 is a year with a softer pace, and it rewards patience more than quick moves. The Wood Rabbit's energy is gentle and social, so you may feel pulled toward steady routines instead of clever shortcuts. This is a good time to finish what you have already started and leave fewer loose threads behind. If you use your curiosity to learn rather than to scatter, the year can feel quietly productive.
monkey.career: At work, your quick thinking is still noticed, but people will value how reliable you are a little more than your speed. Long-running projects, process improvements and mentoring juniors are likely to show steady results. Watch out for taking on too many side tasks because they sound interesting, since that can thin out your attention by mid-year. A simple weekly priority list, kept somewhere you will see it, can keep your best work visible to the people who matter.
monkey.money: Money matters look stable, as long as you keep your habits simple and easy to see. Small, regular amounts set aside tend to work better this year than bursts of effort followed by long gaps. Read the terms on any subscription, instalment plan or group arrangement before agreeing, especially ones offered casually by friends. Going through your spending once a quarter can show you leaks you would otherwise miss.
monkey.love: In relationships, the year asks for warmth more than wit. Partners may want more of your listening than your jokes, so make room for slow conversations, perhaps on an evening walk around the estate. Singles may meet someone through a course, hobby group or friend's gathering rather than through chance encounters. Let trust build at its own pace instead of testing it with games.
monkey.health_wellbeing: Your energy is generally steady, but a busy mind can disturb sleep if you carry screens into bed. Try a regular wind-down routine and some daylight movement, even a short walk before the heat builds. Be kind to your neck and shoulders during long hours at the desk, and stretch now and then. Quiet hobbies with your hands, like cooking or tending plants, can settle a restless mood.
monkey.tai_sui_note: The Monkey has no direct clash or harmony with the Rabbit Tai Sui in 2035, so the year's influence is fairly neutral. That leaves your own choices and habits doing most of the work. Some families still keep a simple custom of offering thanks or quiet reflection at the start of the lunar year, which you may follow if it feels meaningful to you.

rooster.overview: For the Rooster, 2035 brings the energy of a clash year, which usually means change, movement and some unplanned adjustments. Things that seemed fixed may shift, whether at work, at home or in your daily routine. This need not be bad news, because a clash often clears space for something better suited to you. Staying flexible, keeping some buffer in your plans and choosing your words carefully will help a lot.
rooster.career: Work may involve reorganisations, new reporting lines or changes in what is expected of you. Rather than resisting every change, look for the role where your precision and high standards become truly valuable. Keep written notes of decisions and agreements, since misunderstandings are more likely in a clash year. If disagreements come up with colleagues, a calm private conversation will usually work better than a sharp email.
rooster.money: Financial life calls for caution and a good buffer this year. Unexpected costs, such as home repairs, travel changes or family needs, may show up with little warning. Keeping a modest reserve and avoiding hasty big commitments gives you breathing room. When you are unsure, wait a week before deciding and check the details twice.
rooster.love: Relationships may feel more sensitive than usual, with small comments landing harder than you meant them to. Choose gentleness over being right, especially when tired or stressed. Couples can grow closer by facing changes together, for example by planning a home rearrangement or a family schedule as a team. Singles may meet someone unexpected, but take time to see their character before investing deeply.
rooster.health_wellbeing: Clash years can feel tiring, so build rest into your calendar instead of waiting until you are worn out. Take extra care on the road, around the home and during sports, slowing down where you would normally rush. Gentle routines like stretching, steady meals and regular sleep will help keep your mood even. Talking things through with a trusted friend can ease tension before it builds.
rooster.tai_sui_note: The Rooster sits directly opposite the Rabbit, so 2035 is a clash year with Tai Sui. Folk tradition links this to movement and change rather than misfortune, and many people respond by slowing down and acting with extra care. Some choose to pay respects to Tai Sui or wear a small charm early in the year as a custom of reassurance, which is entirely up to you.

dog.overview: For the Dog, 2035 is a warm, supportive year, because the Rabbit and Dog form a six harmony pairing. Help may come from people around you, and cooperation tends to go more smoothly than usual. This is a good year to strengthen partnerships, mend old misunderstandings and build trust. Your loyalty is noticed and appreciated, so let others meet you halfway.
dog.career: Teamwork is your strength this year, and joint projects or partnerships look especially promising. A supportive manager or colleague may open a door, so stay visible and say yes to collaboration where it makes sense. It is also a good time to raise ideas you have held back, since people are more receptive. Keep your boundaries clear, though, so that being helpful does not turn into carrying everyone's workload.
dog.money: Money flows look steady, helped by good relationships and sound routines. Shared plans, such as household budgets with a partner or family, may come together more easily than before. Stay sensible about lending or guaranteeing for others, even when goodwill is high. A clear review of your goals in the first quarter can set a calm direction for the whole year.
dog.love: Love is one of the brighter areas of 2035 for the Dog. Couples may find it easier to talk honestly and plan together, perhaps about a home, travel or family matters. Singles have good chances of meeting someone kind through friends, community activities or work circles. Show your warmth openly instead of waiting to be completely sure.
dog.health_wellbeing: Your wellbeing benefits from company this year, so exercise with friends or family can be especially motivating. Group walks, park connector cycling or a weekly class may keep you consistent. Do not let social plans eat into your sleep and quiet time. Pay attention to stress you carry on behalf of others, and set it down when you can.
dog.tai_sui_note: The Dog forms a six harmony with the Rabbit Tai Sui in 2035, which tradition sees as a friendly, supportive link. It is often read as a year of helpful people and smoother cooperation. Some people mark the lunar new year with a simple gesture of thanks, following whatever family custom they find meaningful.

pig.overview: For the Pig, 2035 is a year of good flow, as the Pig and Rabbit belong to the same three harmony group with the Goat. Things tend to fit together more naturally, and your generous, easygoing nature is well matched to the year. It is a good time to grow skills, deepen friendships and take on steady, considered goals. Combine your optimism with some structure and the year can be quietly rewarding.
pig.career: At work, you may find colleagues more cooperative and your ideas more welcome. Roles involving service, creativity or looking after people can be especially satisfying. Take on a meaningful stretch assignment or learning course while conditions are supportive. Keep track of deadlines carefully, because a relaxed mood can sometimes let small details slip.
pig.money: Finances look generally positive, with steady progress from consistent habits. Your generosity is a strength, but set a comfortable limit for treats, gifts and group outings. A simple automatic saving routine can quietly build security over the year. Review any long-term commitments calmly and make sure they still fit your goals.
pig.love: Relationships feel warm and easy, and this is a lovely year for spending quality time together. Couples can enjoy small shared rituals, like weekend hawker breakfasts or cooking at home. Singles may find connection through mutual friends or shared interests, and things may move naturally without pressure. Be honest about what you want so that kindness is not mistaken for agreement.
pig.health_wellbeing: Your general wellbeing looks good, especially if you keep balance between enjoyment and routine. Watch your portion sizes and late meals during festive seasons and gatherings. Regular movement you enjoy, such as swimming or walking, will help you stay energised. Make time for quiet rest so your cheerful energy does not run down.
pig.tai_sui_note: The Pig is part of the Pig-Rabbit-Goat three harmony group, so 2035 has a supportive link with the Rabbit Tai Sui. Tradition reads this as a year of good cooperation and natural momentum. Some people simply give thanks at the start of the lunar year as a family custom, if it feels right to them.
